proposals.title: Fix autonomy/loop: the wall-clock ceiling is implemented but never tripped by a test
proposals.rationale: loop.py TIMED_OUT branch is only reachable via the combined step-timeout assertion, so an off-by-one in the deadline check would ship unnoticed
evidence: the wall-clock ceiling is implemented but never tripped by a test
an unbounded or early-aborting run could pass CI

proposals.title: prove the bounded-gate precedence is fail-closed and ordered
proposals.rationale: authorize() applies kill switch, governor, rate limit, runaway guard and budget in a fixed order; no test pins that an earlier, stricter gate wins over a later permissive one

proposals.title: Fix providers/council: no test drives VOTE or SYNTHESIS with a member that fails
proposals.rationale: test_council only exercises partial failure under the BEST strategy; the vote/centroid and synthesis paths are untested when a member drops out
evidence: no test drives VOTE or SYNTHESIS with a member that fails
a dropped member could skew the winner or crash synthesis

proposals.title: Fix ai/provider_chain: the all-providers-failed return is never asserted
proposals.rationale: provider_chain.call has a distinct exhaustion branch (success=False, 'All providers failed') that no test pins, so a regression could surface a success-shaped result on total failure
evidence: the all-providers-failed return is never asserted
callers could act on a failed AI call as if it succeeded

proposals.title: Fix transparency/ledger: ledger free-text fields are exported without a redaction test
proposals.rationale: a project-wide redaction utility exists and memory/audit are tested against it, but DecisionLedger/FailureLedger to_dict() free text is not asserted to be secret-free
evidence: ledger free-text fields are exported without a redaction test
a token pasted into a rationale could be exported verbatim
